title: confed status result
description: The `result` of `confed status --json`. Computed entirely from local state: the working files, the base recorded in .state.db, and the last fetched remote versions.

space.description: The space key this directory is bound to.

last_fetch_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of the last successful fetch, or null if the space has never been fetched.

clean.description: True when no page differs from base or remote and every page file parsed.

untracked_files.description: Markdown files in the workspace with no frontmatter; confed ignores them.

unreadable.description: Page files that could not be parsed. Each one also appears in the envelope's warnings.

page_id.description: Absent for a local file that does not exist on the server yet.

path.description: Workspace-relative path. Empty for a remote_new page, which has no file yet.

state.description: See docs/sync.md for what causes each state.

base_version.description: The server version this file was last synced with.

remote_version.description: The server version seen by the last fetch.

moved_from.description: Present when the file was renamed or moved since the last sync.

tampered_fields.description: Fields of the tool-managed `confed:` block that were hand-edited. push refuses these pages.

comment_drafts.description: Comments drafted locally — `<!--c new …-->` marks in the body plus `confed:new` entries in the sidecar — that the next push posts. Omitted when zero.

orphaned_comments.description: Open inline comments whose anchor text can no longer be found in the page. Omitted when zero.
